import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import pandas as pd

# Load the dataset from the CSV file
sleep_health = pd.read_csv('data/sleep_health.csv')

# Create a figure with two subplots
fig, axs = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(15, 6))

# Scatter plot of Heart Rate vs Sleep Duration with regression line
sns.regplot(x='Sleep Duration', y='Heart Rate', data=sleep_health, ax=axs[0])
axs[0].set_title('Heart Rate vs Sleep Duration')
axs[0].set_xlabel('Sleep Duration')
axs[0].set_ylabel('Heart Rate')

# Boxplot of Sleep Duration by Gender
sns.boxplot(x='Gender', y='Sleep Duration', data=sleep_health, ax=axs[1])
axs[1].set_title('Sleep Duration by Gender')
axs[1].set_xlabel('Gender')
axs[1].set_ylabel('Sleep Duration')

# Layout so plots do not overlap
fig.tight_layout()

# Save the figure to a file
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
